newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnian company clinches $59 mln deal with Libya.
newsitem.headline: Bosnian company clinches $59 mln deal with Libya.

text.p: A Bosnian engineering company has won a $59 million contract to install 847 kms (525 miles) of long-distance power lines in Libya, a company official said on Friday.
"This is the biggest contract we've had in Libya in the last twenty years," Energoinvest's deputy manager Abdulharis Seta told Reuters.
Energoinvest, a multi-disciplinary engineering firm based in Sarajevo, was given 27 months to complete the work that includes planning the project, producing the steel and installing the power line.
The 14,000 tonnes of steel will be produced in a Sarajevo power line company and will take 18 months to be completed, Seta said.
